bifrost: springboard/render/src/font.rs, springboard/render/src/cff.rs, springboard/render/src/gvar.rs, springboard/render/src/fontprefs.rs, springboard/render/src/emoji.rs, springboard/sdk/src/attributed.rs, springboard/sdk/src/layer_kinds/text.rs, springboard/ui/src/text.rs, springboard/src/shell/browser/layout2/text.rs
summary: BifrOSt has a TrueType and CFF font engine with metrics, cmap glyph lookup, variable-font axes and an attributed string model with line wrapping and truncation. It has no app-facing font objects, font manager, OpenType shaping (kerning, ligatures outside colour emoji), paragraph styles, tabs, bidi or vertical text.

features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/fontobj.rs (FontObject, FontSpec, FontManager); springboard/render/src/font.rs (Font::parse); springboard/render/src/fontprefs.rs (installed, map_font); springboard/sdk/src/font_substitution.rs; springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-complete-17.rs; springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-17.rs
features.note: Apps get a FontObject, a FontSpec descriptor and a FontManager through bifrost_app::fontobj; the manager registers, unregisters and matches faces, and descriptors fill in names, traits and size, all tested headless. Gap: there is no Font Book style install and validation UI, and the system roles still take their face from settings. Refreshed 2026-10-17: covered by bifrost-render render/src/fontobj.rs (FontSpec, FontObject), re-exported to apps as bifrost_app::fontobj; tests fontobj::tests.

features.feature: Font collections and font manager (registration, enumeration, activation)
features.note: Registration from bytes or a file, removal, change events, named collections and matching are tested in render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-19.rs. Gap: auto-activation is stored but nothing reads it, so no missing font is activated on demand; fontprefs::installed lists faces for Settings only. Refreshed 2026-10-17: fontobj.rs FontManager registers, unregisters and reports changes (FontEvent); tests fontobj::tests.

features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/font.rs (Font::glyph, Font::glyph_named, lookup); springboard/render/src/fontobj.rs (glyph_for_char, with_glyph_override, fallback_runs); springboard/render/src/fontfallback.rs (split); springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-complete-17.rs
features.note: cmap formats 4 and 12 (Unicode) and CFF glyph names, with misses at glyph 0, per-font glyph overrides and cascade runs through script faces, all tested headless. Gap: the lab machine has not compared the fallback choices with the reference system.

features.apple: CTFontGetAscent, CTFontGetDescent, CTFontGetLeading, CTFontGetCapHeight, CTFontGetXHeight, CTFontGetUnderlinePosition
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/font.rs (line_metrics, ascent, descent from hhea; advance from hmtx; measure); springboard/render/src/fontobj.rs (FontObject metrics); springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-complete-17.rs
features.note: Ascent, descent, leading, cap height, x-height and underline position and thickness are read from hhea, OS/2 and post, and tested on the packed face. Gap: the values are not compared with the reference system on the lab machine. Refreshed 2026-10-17: leading, cap height, x-height and underline values are read in render fontobj.rs and fontinfo.rs; tests fontinfo::tests.

TrueType glyf and CFF Type 2 outlines are flattened to segments and rasterised; the outline of a letter is non-empty and the space has none, tested headless. Gap: no path object is exposed to apps and there is no direct glyph drawing API outside the UI text path.

features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/gvar.rs, springboard/render/src/font.rs (axes, measure_var, advance_var, render_var); springboard/render/src/fontobj.rs (variation_axes, with_variations); springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-complete-17.rs
features.note: fvar, avar and gvar are applied; axis tags and ranges reach apps through FontObject, a later value replaces an earlier one, and a heavier weight widens glyph advances, all tested headless. Gap: rendered instances are not compared with the reference on the lab machine.

features.apple: CTTypesetter shaping via GSUB and GPOS, kCTFontOpenTypeFeatureTag
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-core-text, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No GPOS and no kern table reader. Plain text is laid out by summing advances, so pairs are not kerned. No OpenType feature selection. Refreshed 2026-10-17: render kern.rs reads kern-table pair kerning (tests kern::tests). GPOS and feature selection remain open.

features.apple: Styling Attributed Strings: kCTFontAttributeName, kCTForegroundColorAttributeName, kCTUnderlineStyleAttributeName, kCTBackgroundColorAttributeName
features.note: Bold, italic, size class, colour token, underline, strikethrough and link are tested headless in parity_sdk-tests-11.rs, including set, get, enumerate and remove for each key. Font family, foreground and background colour, baseline and kerning values are stored and round-trip through set and get, but drawing them is not tested. Gap: the classic range methods count characters, not UTF-16 units (only the accessibility runs count UTF-16). Refreshed 2026-10-17: paragraph styles in ui paragraph.rs (ParagraphStyle) and line and frame layout in ui typeset.rs (Typesetter, Framesetter); tests paragraph::tests, typeset::tests.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 21 tests. Only line wrapping and head, middle and tail truncation. No alignment, indents, spacing, tab stops or line-height settings on attributed strings.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 21 tests. Greedy word wrap and binary-search truncation against a caller-supplied measure function. No grapheme or script-aware break rules beyond whitespace. Browser layout has its own wrapper in springboard/src/shell/browser/layout2/text.rs.

features.feature: Line and run layout objects (typesetter, framesetter, line, run, frame)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 3 tests. Wave 5 (theme-03, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No layout object exposed to apps and no glyph run or line geometry query. RichTextView::draw wraps styled runs into a Surface, and the text buffer handles editing. Caret and hit-testing are not in draw.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 23 tests. Wave 2 (theme-32, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No bidi algorithm and no right-to-left layout in the text path.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. Wave 4 (theme-17, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No vertical layout.
Audit 2026-10-13: the row predated this code. Pure model with host unit tests (ruby.rs); not wired into the shell or apps, not tested on Midget. No ruby text. Low priority outside CJK locales.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 10 tests. Wave 4 (theme-24, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No way to place an image or view inside styled text.

features.feature: Font family substitution, system designs and cascade lists
features.apple: CTFontDescriptorCreateMatchingFontDescriptors, CTFontDescriptorCreateWithNameAndSize, kCTFontCascadeListAttribute, CTFontCopyDefaultCascadeListForLanguages, system design (rounded, serif, monospaced)
features.note: A family the library lacks resolves to an open equivalent by class (grotesque, geometric, humanist, serif, slab, script, mono, rounded, CJK gothic/mincho/kai/rounded); unknown names fall back by traits. with_design maps rounded/serif/monospaced; cascade_list orders script families per language tag (tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10-fonts-w7.rs, font_substitution tests). Matching returns Installed records, not descriptor objects with mandatory-key sets; equivalents are other designs, and the listed open families must be installed in the font library. Not yet checked on Midget. Refreshed 2026-10-17: fallback faces in render fontfallback.rs (install_from_manager, runs); tests fontfallback::tests.

gaps: No GPOS reader and no feature selection: render kern.rs reads kern-table pair kerning only; no ligatures outside colour emoji.
